digest.component_or_area: import parser and CLI help generation
propositions: Current import documentation and help text do not accurately describe the batching carveout, 256-event chunk passes, and deferred-push behavior delivered by ADR 0039 and cold-stall-chalk.

The canonical import parser help must be updated to document batch-independent create, parent, file-impact, verify-command, and comment passes; per-event link and status passes; and serial source-id-based resumption.
Generated CLI help and CLI reference artifacts must be regenerated from canonical parser help to reflect the current import batching and recovery semantics.
Import documentation must explicitly state that whole-file atomicity is not provided, partial tickets may remain incomplete after crash, and concurrent imports risk duplicate creation.
Documentation changes must not alter importer runtime behavior or module implementation.
